title: Reviewers take held-out examples from where the architect keeps them
situation: Held-out examples reached a story's reviewers through the lead, who runs the build they are held from.
decision: Held-out examples are kept with the design, apart from the visible examples, and a story's reviewers take them from there directly, never through the lead, so nothing about them passes through whoever runs the build. They are never named in a task; a failing one reaches a builder only as its concept and the shortfall. No mechanism prevents reading them and no instruction forbids it, since a prohibition would announce them.
consequences: The held-out example and lead concepts state this.
